trajectory.thought: The leader is a seeded baseline (full-pool mean) and the verdict is "indistinguishable" — the runner-up is not statistically better. Accepting the leader is the correct call.

action_args.justification: The series is trend-dominated (strength 0.82) with weak seasonality (0.27) and non-stationary. Model ranking is unstable across windows (Kendall tau -0.014), which means no subset of models is reliably superior. The full-pool mean (19 models) outperforms every smaller-pool variant (pool1=5, pool2=7, pool3=9) and every alternative combination (median, DBA, weighted, trimmed), confirming that the diversity of the full pool is the key source of accuracy. The leader is a seed baseline with an 'indistinguishable' margin to the runner-up, and no tested strategy has separated from it. Accepting the full-pool mean is the robust choice for this series.
